workItem: Add owner-gated automation that inspects unsigned PR commits and, after explicit workflow_dispatch apply, recreates the PR head as one verified-signed squash commit without merging or weakening repository rulesets.
workItemDE: Owner-gesteuerte Commit-Signing-Automatisierung: unsigned PR-Commits prüfen und nach explizitem Apply als einen signierten Squash-Commit auf dem PR-Branch neu erzeugen. Kein Self-Merge, kein Ruleset-Apply.
releaseCondition: Claim is released when the pull request is merged, closed, superseded or abandoned. Merge remains Human/Owner-only.
notes: Does not re-enable required_signatures. Owner disabled that rule on 2026-08-30; reactivation remains a separate ruleset-admin decision.
Does not mutate .github/policies/main-production-protection.expected.json or docs/architecture/ROADMAP.md (open PR #611).
No self-merge. No production, Render, Supabase or Stripe mutation.
Apply mode requires Owner-provided GPG secrets and fails closed without them.
